Markets.title: Tata Motors launches tender offer for Iveco Group; deal values company at €3.82 billion
Markets.summary: Tata Motors has launched a €3.82 billion cash tender offer to fully acquire and delist Italian commercial vehicle maker Iveco Group. The €14.1-per-share deal is supported by Iveco's largest shareholder, Exor, following strong commercial vehicle sales by Tata Motors.

Markets.title: FIIs are coming back: Can Indian stocks sustain buying for 3rd consecutive month in September?
Markets.summary: Foreign investors poured over $3.2 billion into Indian equities in August, driven by strong GDP growth, stable currency, and solid corporate earnings. HSBC estimates that returning to neutral allocations could bring up to $25 billion more into the market.

Markets.title: ITC’s tobacco business is going cheap but Kotak Institutional Equities thinks market has it wrong
Markets.summary: Kotak Institutional Equities believes ITC's tobacco business is undervalued at 11 times forward earnings. The brokerage suggests that splitting the tobacco and non-tobacco operations would unlock significant shareholder value.

Markets.title: FII money trail: Where did overseas investors put money in second half of August after $3 billion inflow?
Markets.summary: Foreign portfolio investors poured over $3.2 billion into Indian equities in August, achieving their highest monthly inflow since September 2024. Consumer Services, Financial Services, and Healthcare led the buying, while Telecom and Power experienced significant outflows.

Markets.title: Former Tata Technologies CEO McGoldrick sells shares worth Rs 165 crore
Markets.summary: Former Tata Technologies CEO Patrick McGoldrick sold 21 lakh shares worth Rs 165 crore, reducing his stake to 0.62 percent. Mutual funds and asset management firms purchased these shares at Rs 785 each.

Markets.title: Bitcoin trades at $79,000, next week’s US inflation data to test rate-cut hopes and crypto valuations
Markets.summary: Bitcoin traded near $79,000 as investors awaited upcoming US inflation data to gauge potential Federal Reserve interest rate cuts. Meanwhile, Ethereum and major altcoins declined, though institutional demand for crypto remained strong through exchange-traded fund inflows.

Geo-Political.title: US envoys meet Putin in Moscow for Ukraine talks
Geo-Political.summary: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow. During the meeting, Putin stated that the current situation regarding Ukraine is not easy.

Geo-Political.title: US and Iran trade retaliatory attacks on ships as conflict flares
Geo-Political.summary: The United States military stated that it struck three Iranian oil tankers in retaliation. In response, Iran reported that it successfully targeted three ships linked to the United States.

Geo-Political.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
Geo-Political.summary: A mistrial was declared in the Lindsay Clancy murder case after the jury deadlocked. The outcome leaves her potential criminal liability for the deaths of her three children unresolved.

Geo-Political.title: At least two dead in blast at Bolivia military barracks
Geo-Political.summary: At least two people died in an explosion at a military barracks in Viacha, Bolivia. Authorities warned residents to stay away from the area due to the risk of additional blasts.

Geo-Political.title: Prince William to attend King Harald's funeral in Norway
Geo-Political.summary: Prince William will represent the British monarch at the funeral of King Harald V in Oslo next week. The service for the late Norwegian king is scheduled to take place in the coming days.

Geo-Political.title: TV presenter among 11 sentenced to death in Egypt drugs case
Geo-Political.summary: Egyptian TV presenter Sarah Khalifa is among 11 individuals sentenced to death in a drug case. Khalifa is best known for hosting the crime-focused television program "Mission Impossible."

Data & Insights.title: India GDP grows 7.8%, but PM Modi urges less gold purchase, foreign travel: Does it help the economy? Expert weighs in
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged Indians to reduce foreign travel and gold purchases to help India achieve its goal of becoming a developed economy by 2047. The appeal follows India's recent GDP growth of 7.8 percent, prompting economic experts to weigh in on how these consumer spending choices impact the national economy.

Data & Insights.summary: President Trump is urging the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates to stimulate the economy. However, economists warn that this policy could cause inflation to rise.

Data & Insights.summary: President Trump is pressuring Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh to lower interest rates despite market expectations for a rate hike. Next week's inflation data, following a strong jobs report, will likely determine the Fed's final decision.

Data & Insights.title: Boost for Indian economy after 7.8% GDP; Japan agency upgrades sovereign rating from BBB+ to A- | Difference explained
Data & Insights.summary: Japan Credit Rating Agency has upgraded India's sovereign credit rating from BBB+ to A- with a stable outlook. This upgrade follows India's strong 7.8 percent GDP growth and reflects confidence in the country's economic stability.

Data & Insights.summary: This weekly compilation features data-driven charts analyzing recent economic stories reported by Mint. Key topics include GDP growth resilience, a factory slowdown, and a continuous GST revenue streak.

Data & Insights.summary: President Trump pressured Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh to lower interest rates. He also threatened to cut trade with countries that maintain trade deficits with the United States.

India.title: Centre Appoints 8 Chief Justices In High Courts Across India
India.summary: The central government has appointed eight new Chief Justices to various High Courts across India. Justice Ravindra V Ghuge will lead the Calcutta High Court, and Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi will head the Bombay High Court.

India.title: Mayawati's Tough Love: Nephew Akash Anand Benched Again. What It Means For BSP
India.summary: BSP leader Mayawati has sidelined her 31-year-old nephew and political successor, Akash Anand, for the third time in three years. This decision regarding Anand was announced in Lucknow on September 3.

India.title: Delhi Teenager Returns Home Late, Family Scolds Her. She Dies By Suicide
India.summary: A Delhi teenager died by suicide after her family scolded her for returning home late. Her sister found her hanging and brought her down before police discovered her unconscious on the floor.

India.title: Census 2027: Population Enumeration In 4 Poll-Bound States From December 1
India.summary: Population enumeration for India's upcoming census will begin on December 1 in four poll-bound states. The enumeration process for the rest of the country is expected to start in February, excluding regions affected by snow.

India.title: BJP Commits To 'Tripartite Agreement' In Tripura
India.summary: Tripura Chief Minister Manik Saha traveled to New Delhi to discuss a "tripartite agreement" with Union Home Minister Amit Shah and TIPRA Motha chief Pradyot Kishore Debbarma. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has committed to this agreement to address the demands of the indigenous people of Tripura.

India.title: 7-Year-Old Among 2 Dead, 212 Injured During Mumbai Dahi Handi Celebrations
India.summary: Two people died, including a 7-year-old child, during Dahi Handi celebrations in the Mumbai region. Additionally, 212 participants were injured while forming human pyramids in Mumbai and Thane.
